name: site-time-limit
description: Firefox extension that limits daily time spent on specific sites

scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files .idea package.json package-lock.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts scripts README.md .amo-upload-uuid
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel=unlisted --ignore-files .idea package.json package-lock.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts scripts README.md .amo-upload-uuid
